estimand.name: progression_or_death_before_or_in_competition_with_switch
estimand.switch: distinct observed competing cause; never collapsed into progression/death or censoring
estimand.zero_time: survival_time_days <= 0 excluded by frozen supervised eligibility rule

primary_metric.name: PATIENT_BALANCED_PFS_BRIER_4H_MEAN
primary_metric.clarification: Arithmetic mean of four fixed-horizon IPCW Brier scores, not a continuous-time numerical integral.
primary_metric.patient_balance: Each row receives 1 / number_of_evaluation_landmarks_for_its_patient before horizon-specific IPCW weighting.
primary_metric.censoring_km: Fit once on CHORD original-training survival rows only; censoring is the KM event and progression/death/switch are non-censoring observations.
primary_metric.switch_at_or_before_horizon: observed non-case for progression/death subdistribution Brier target

legacy_replay.name: LEGACY_MONTH_CEILING_NLL
legacy_replay.rule: Events use containing month; censoring uses no-event probability through the entire containing month via ceil(time/month_width).
legacy_replay.known_approximation: Interior-bin censoring contributes unobserved remainder of the containing month. Historical values remain immutable.

v2_supporting.name: FRACTIONAL_CENSOR_NLL_V1
v2_supporting.event_rule: Event retains interval-event mass in its containing month.
v2_supporting.censor_rule: Completed bins contribute full log no-event probability; the observed fraction of an interior censoring bin contributes fraction * log(no-event probability), equivalent to a constant within-bin total hazard interpolation.
v2_supporting.selection_role: secondary/supporting; does not replace the locked primary Brier metric

bootstrap.resampling: sample patient clusters with replacement; every draw is retained as a distinct bootstrap cluster even when the same source patient is selected multiple times
